fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh of links that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Shackles
fusions.desc: Loops a linked mesh over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and leaving each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Purse Line
fusions.desc: Lays a drawstring loop 4 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it.

fusions.name: Cracked Lash
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a length of linked cord lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Once every 5 seconds.
